title: A remoteness formula for generalized Wythoff games
summary: Smith's remoteness function records how long an impartial game lasts when the winner wins as quickly as possible and the loser delays defeat. For the generalized Wythoff game $\mathrm{WYT}(a,b)$, in which two positive integer parameters $a$ and $b$ determine which simultaneous removals from the two piles are allowed, we give a formula for the remoteness of every position, building on the known values at losing positions.
